text:
alex: quick heads-up — ran the nightly link-scan and it flagged ~18 dead anchors across runtime-guide and api-examples. not urgent P0 but want these cleaned up before next doc release :eyes:

docs-bot: LinkScan finished — 18 dead links found. Breakdown: runtime-guide (6), api-examples (7), kb/quickstart (3). Full CSV: /internal/reports/linkscan/2891234567.csv

maya: can you paste the offending paths? i can take api-examples if they're small edits :hand:

alex: pasted the short hits below — most are missing heading slugs after heading refactor last sprint:
```
# sample grep output
docs/api-examples/embeddings.md:href="/runtime-guide#kv-cache-behavior"
docs/runtime-guide/ops.md:href="/api-examples#batching-config"
docs/kb/quickstart.md:href="/runtime-guide#startup-latency"
```

tj: i'll take the runtime-guide ones. quick question — do we prefer to re-add anchors or change links to current slugs?

linh: prefer updating links to canonical slugs if the content was merged/renamed. only re-add anchors if we intentionally keep the old slug for compat.

alex: cool — assignment then: tj = runtime-guide (6), maya = api-examples (7), sam = kb/quickstart (3). please open small PRs and tag @docs. keep changes to the link targets and add redirect frontmatter only if needed.

sam: ack. i'll do a single PR for the 3 quickstart fixes. planning to run a local link-check with `yarn docs:link-check` before pushing.

maya: starting now. will aim for 1 PR per file for easier review.

alex: tiny helper command i used to find the broken anchors if useful:
```bash
# finds HTML anchor refs that 404 against current site map (dev tools)
python scripts/linkscan.py --project docs --output /tmp/links.csv --check-anchors
```

maya: noted. small nit — when updating, please also fix alt text on any images I touch; saw a couple missing.

linh: also leave a short changelog line in PR body: "fix broken anchors after heading rename (linkscan 2891234567)" so QA can track.

alex: putting an example PR body in case folks want it:
> Fix broken anchors reported by nightly link-scan (2891234567)
> - Update links in api-examples/embeddings.md to match renamed headings
> - Run `yarn docs:link-check` and confirm no new failures
> - cc @docs for quick review

tj: done with runtime-guide edits, opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590 — small fixes, left redirects out because slugs changed cleanly.

docs-bot: PR opened by tj: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590 — CI: docs-build ✅, link-check ✅

maya: PR opened for api-examples: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4591 — had to update two image paths too.

sam: kb PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4592 — added tiny copy tweak while I was there.

alex: awesome, thanks all. i'll queue a quick review pass today and merge if CI is green. after merges, i'll re-run the nightly scan and confirm it's clean. :thumbsup:

linh: one follow-up — can we add the link-scan job to the release checklist so we don't ship with >5 dead links? i'll open a tiny docs PR for the checklist.

alex: yes please. ping me on that PR and i'll approve.

maya: nice workflow — felt quick. thanks everyone.
